notes.title: BouleMan
notes.content: [p]🎉 BouleMan – Even More Fun for the Whole Family![/p][p]Hello to all BouleMan fans 👋,[/p][p]We're excited to announce a new update that makes your favorite game even more fun, accessible, and family-friendly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657081/ee298388f2e6630e582572c92f43f4702cf1feaf.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Official launch of BouleMan
notes.content: [p][b]BouleMan is a fun and family-friendly game designed for players of all ages. Whether you're a young gamer discovering your first adventure or an adult looking for a lighthearted experience, BouleMan has something for everyone.[/b][/p][p]Enjoy up to [b]5 save slots[/b], allowing each player to have their own personalized journey and continue right where they left off. The game is [b]simple to pick up[/b], with intuitive controls, [b]charming graphics[/b], and [b]customization options[/b] that make every game feel unique.[/p][p]Whether you're playing solo or sharing the fun with friends and family, BouleMan offers a delightful world full of laughter, color, and surprises. Perfect for casual gaming sessions, it’s a great way to relax, have fun, and spark your imagination.[/p][p][b]Simple, charming, and endlessly enjoyable — BouleMan is the perfect game for kids and grown-ups alike.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657081/d5c6acb45c9a011389f4126f43ded272d27ce5f4.png"][/img][/p]
